_comment: Template for Railway → Variables → Raw Editor (JSON mode). Run `npm run env:railway` to generate railway.env.json with the real values filled in from .env.local; that file is gitignored. Never commit real values.
ADMIN_SECRET: <required — MUST match the current deployment byte-for-byte: it signs every qwen_session cookie and /api/media token, so a different value logs everyone out and 404s issued image URLs>
LINK_BOT_SECRET: <required — must be identical to the value on the Discord bot's host, or /link returns 401>
_bot: The Discord link bot runs inside this same service, started alongside the site. Without DISCORD_TOKEN the supervisor skips it and the site runs alone.
DISCORD_TOKEN: <the bot token from the Discord Developer Portal — Bot -> Reset Token>
DISCORD_GUILD_ID: <optional but recommended: your server id. /link appears there instantly; without it registration is global and Discord can take an hour to propagate>
WHITELIST_CHANNEL: <optional: channel id where /link is allowed. Used elsewhere it replies with a pointer to this channel, and non-command messages posted in it are deleted, which needs Manage Messages>
_optional: Everything below only needs setting if you are overriding a default.
CRON_SECRET: <optional but recommended off Vercel: /api/cron/cleanup is unauthenticated unless this is set>
_do_not_set: PORT is injected by Railway and read by the standalone server. NODE_ENV is set in the Dockerfile. DEV_MASTER_KEY is a local-only auth bypass and must never be set on a deployed host.
